reason: The README clearly describes a DeepSeek Harness bundle focused on configurable subagent delegation, including per-call model, provider, persona, and tool-filter overrides plus preset integration.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的子代理委派工具增加按调用配置模型、提供方、角色和工具过滤器的能力，并支持从本地预设引用角色。
summaries.en: Enhances DeepSeek Harness subagent delegation with per-call model, provider, persona, and tool-filter overrides, including references to local agent presets.

capabilities: Replaces the standard subagent and subagent_fork tools
Supports per-call model and provider overrides for delegated subagents
Supports per-call persona and tool allow/deny filter overrides
Resolves persona references from saved agent presets
Provides an adapter for selecting the enhanced tools in web sessions
